title: Five days. Five katoris.
caption:
Diwali is five days long, so we served it the only way an Indian house would. One thali, five katoris.

Dhanteras to Bhai Dooj, one piece for each day. The menu is on the last slide. The pieces are shown larger than life in the katoris.

No Indian mother has ever let anyone leave after one serving. Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. Your bag applies the code, BUY2 or BUY3, by itself.

Today's mangal: Tamil, மங்கலம். In Chennai a thali is something else entirely. This one is lunch.

[ the mangal thali · gold tone and two-tone · ek aur ]
first_comment: Which katori is yours? Free insured shipping. Cash on delivery available. #NairaFlore #DiwaliGifting #Dhanteras #BhaiDooj #DemiFineJewellery
alt_text: Slide 1: on a deep red ground, a top-down drawing of one large steel katori holding a real gold-tone knot bangle, a ribbed coil crossed by a polished X. Behind it a steel thali enters from the right edge with two more katoris on it, cut by the frame, one holding a fine tennis bracelet of clear stones and the other gold-tone flower studs. Text: House rule 03, the Mangal Thali, vol 1. Five days. Five katoris. And still, someone will ask: ek aur? At the foot, the NAIRA and MANGAL seal with the Tamil word மங்கலம் and a small steel key.

Slide 2: on blush, one large steel katori holding the gold-tone Kiss Knot Bangle, a ribbed coil crossed by a polished X. Text: The Mangal Thali, 1 of 5. Dhanteras. Something new and something metal, as the day asks. Gold tone or rhodium, your call. Kiss Knot Bangle, 1,199 rupees. 18K gold tone plated or rhodium silver tone plated.

Slide 3: on plum, a steel katori with a fine gold rim line holding the Fine Tennis Bracelet, one row of clear round stones in gold-tone claws. Text: The Mangal Thali, 2 of 5. Choti Diwali. Up before sunrise for the oil bath. One line of light for the evening. Fine Tennis Bracelet, 1,299 rupees. 18K gold tone plated, clear cubic zirconia.

Slide 4: on bottle green, a steel katori holding the Baguette Tennis Necklace in Crystal, coiled in the bowl, its strand climbing over the right rim and running across the green ground off the right edge of the frame. Text: The Mangal Thali, 3 of 5. Lakshmi Puja. The evening the good things come out. Crystal, at the base of the neck. Baguette Tennis Necklace, Crystal, 2,300 rupees. 18K gold tone plated, 36 cm.

Slide 5: on lilac, two steel katoris side by side, one holding the Duo Link Necklace with gold-tone and rhodium-coated links, the other the gold-tone Petal Flower Studs. Text: The Mangal Thali, 4 and 5 of 5. Padwa. The aukshan, then the gift. Two tones in one chain, like two people in one house. Duo Link Necklace, 1,299 rupees. Two-tone, gold tone and rhodium coated links. Bhai Dooj. For the sister who still counts the toffees. Four petals, close to the lobe. Petal Flower Studs, 999 rupees. 18K gold tone plated.

Slide 6: a cream menu card with a double red rule, on a deep red ground. Served all five days. Today's Thali. Ek aur? There is always room for one more. Five numbered lines with dotted leaders: 1, Dhanteras, Kiss Knot Bangle, 1,199 rupees. 2, Choti Diwali, Fine Tennis Bracelet, 1,299 rupees. 3, Lakshmi Puja, Baguette Tennis Necklace, 2,300 rupees. 4, Padwa, Duo Link Necklace, 1,299 rupees. 5, Bhai Dooj, Petal Flower Studs, 999 rupees. A small gold lozenge between two gold rules closes the list. Below the card, the NAIRA and MANGAL seal with the Tamil word மங்கலம் and a small steel key.
